sources.license: Celestica original installation guide; factual SKU/configuration extraction, source rights retained
sources.coverage: Eight complete chassis SKU rows visually reviewed on physical PDF pages 7 and 8 (printed pages 4 and 5) of the original Celestica DS4000/DS4001 installation guide. Six DS4000 and two DS4001 ordering configurations, not eight new model families. Accessories are excluded from chassis identifiers. Each SKU has its own source record and verbatim configuration description. Brand/vendor documentation does not establish physical factory, hyperscaler deployment, current availability, firmware entitlement or the configuration of an auction unit. PSU quantities and ratings are not measured power draw; F2B/B2F tokens retain the published meaning without suffix decoding.
